result: {"episodeSummary":"The FSJam hosts explore the challenges of building third-party JavaScript widgets through Everfund’s donation SDK. They discuss module formats, browser compatibility, bundling, CDN hosting, and framework integration, showing how a seemingly simple embed becomes a complex developer-experience problem. Comparing iframe-based widgets with content injected directly into a page, they weigh isolation and easier updates against customization and cross-origin concerns. Everfund’s WordPress troubleshooting and plans for a headless donation API illustrate the trade-offs, while its open-source SDK offers a starting point for others. The conversation shifts to documentation, distinguishing tutorials, how-to guides, explanations, and API references before considering the podcast’s future. The hosts favor occasional guest-free discussions and carefully vetted sponsorships to support production without sacrificing listener trust. Reflecting on favorite guests and emerging frameworks, they emphasize education-first advocacy and a lasting record of web development ideas, inviting listeners to suggest topics and help shape the show."}
